subject.title: Feature: Private Mode for demos and content creation

question: What exact privacy guarantee should a private session make, including remote-provider use, durable operational metadata, tool/media/plugin persistence, and which UI or channel actors may enable it?
rationale: Those choices determine whether the feature is an honest no-persist security boundary or only a context-suppression convenience mode; implementation cannot safely infer that contract.

options.title: Approve an enforceable ephemeral-session contract
options.body: Define private mode as a per-session no-workspace-read and no-durable-content-persistence contract, enumerate tightly limited retained metadata, and then implement it across the identified boundaries.

options.title: Scope a demo-only context mode
options.body: Limit the feature to suppressing bootstrap workspace context and label it as a non-security presentation mode without claiming no persistence.

options.title: Defer until a privacy model is sponsored
options.body: Keep the tracker open without implementation until an owner approves the security, provider, and retention policy.

recommendation.title: Approve an enforceable ephemeral-session contract
recommendation.body: Define private mode as a per-session no-workspace-read and no-durable-content-persistence contract, enumerate tightly limited retained metadata, and then implement it across the identified boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent tracker review maps the affected session and Gateway contracts and is the strongest available ownership signal.
